title: fix(pm): first-touch sweep and H13 read area:* instead of domain:*; the sweep's daily backstop reads the issue type
body:

_Requested by **Warren, Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXFRsfSS1tQB1kBxAZ86579)_

Part of #35234

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;分诊每天查「新卡有没有分流」时,改看卡的业务区和卡的类型,不再看旧的技术分组标签。
- 为什么做:分诊现在给新卡标的是业务区,巡检还在看旧标签,会把已分好的卡当成没分、把只剩旧标签的卡当成分好了;这是技能评审改进顺序里「车道改成席位加专题」的脚本部分。
- 出错会怎样:只影响巡检报告,不改任何卡;上线后头一轮会多报几张没标业务区或类型的卡,整体撤回即复原。
- 要你做什么:无(旧技术分组标签何时退役,等剩下几处读取迁走后再请你定)。

## What changes

### Reviewer quick look (moved from the brief)

- 先看:`scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` 的 `classify()` 与新 `lacksType()`;`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h13AreaWithoutPmState()`;`triage-duties.md` 三行规则措辞。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test`,预期「63 cases pass across 6 batteries」。

Closes only the sweep and H13 half of the card: six `domain:*` card-label readings outside this card's surface (listed below) still have to move before the card's Done-when holds, so this PR is a part, and the card stays open for them.


- `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`: the four label disjunctions read `area:*` (the label triage's first touch writes) where they read `domain:*`. A card carrying only a `domain:*` is now as unrouted as a bare one: disjunct ① lists it, and ② lists a `pm:queue` card whose only lane reading is a `domain:*`. The daily backstop (outside the verdict and the exit code, as before) gains a second row: open cards whose issue type (`type.name` on the REST row) is empty, with the sweep's exclusions only: no label excuses a type (`security` is exempt on the area row alone, as before). `--json` gains `no_type`.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H13: `h13DomainWithoutPmState` becomes `h13AreaWithoutPmState`, and `DOMAIN_HALF_STATE_STALE_HOURS` becomes `AREA_HALF_STATE_STALE_HOURS` (same 2h value). The finding text names `area:*`. No other module imports either name (repo-wide `git grep`: zero hits).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`: the sweep rule lines ①–④ and the daily backstop line, which now scans for a missing `area:*` or type and still ends in 补齐 (same line count, every line within the 120-byte budget; the sweep's self-test pins these phrases verbatim). Per the claim's surface amendment.

### For the maintainer: retiring the `domain:*` labels (NOT done in this PR)

The card's last step, retiring the `domain:*` labels, is yours to confirm after this lands and the sweep runs clean on the live board. Before you do, these scripts outside this card's surface still read a card's `domain:*` label to judge it. Retiring the labels before they move would silence them, without any error. They belong to the lane-to-seat change, not to this card:

| Script · reading | What it judges from `domain:*` |
|---|---|
| `check-half-states.mjs` H71 (`h71UnclaimedOnDutyLane`) | a `pm:queue` card on a lane whose seat is on duty but has not claimed it |
| `check-half-states.mjs` H32 lane inventory (in `sweepInto`) | unclaimed and in-flight counts per lane seat |
| `check-half-states.mjs` H73 (`h73RuledCardStillInBox`) | which lane seat owes the exit from the decision box |
| `check-half-states.mjs` H74 (`h74InheritsFromParent`) | a sub-issue inherits its parent's `domain:*` or grade, so it owes no first-touch audit comment |
| `check-owed-reviews.mjs` (the PR's lane seat) | which lane seat takes an owed review |
| `fleet-roster.mjs` (seat row vs card) | whether a `domain:` seat row owns a card |

The other `domain:` hits under `scripts/pm/` are not readings of a card's label: seat names and signatures (`domain:skills#2`), the seat-post title parser, the retired-lane alias rewrites on writes (`issue-create`, `label-write`, `fleet-write/dispatch`), label creation (`ensure-pm-labels.sh`), self-test fixtures and comments.

## Tests

<details><summary>Self-tests (head 7804d1c46b)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test` exit 0: `✓ first-touch-sweep self-test: 63 cases pass across 6 batteries — offline, no network.` The classifier battery pin goes 16 → 18 and the backstop battery 9 → 14 (its registered count). The H13 fixture builder is named `labelledCard`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` exit 0: `✓ check-half-states self-test: 5323 cases pass.` H13 adds four cases: a `domain:*` alone is out of scope, the same card with an `area:*` is the finding, and the row names `area:*` and never `domain`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: each new reading goes red when it is reverted (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob each time)</summary>

- `classify()` reads `domain:` again: first-touch self-test exit 1, `11 of 65 case(s) failed` (on d6f79bbd8a). Restored, blob `e6892e6b1219` matches HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- H13 reads `domain:` again: check-half-states self-test exit 1, `12 of 5323 case(s) failed`. Restored, blob `9358b8d0d630` matches HEAD.
- `lacksType()` always answers false: first-touch self-test exit 1, `3 of 65 case(s) failed` (on d6f79bbd8a: the type row, the walk's `no_type`, the rendered line). Restored, blob matches HEAD.
- On 7804d1c46b, `lacksType()` exempts `security` again: first-touch self-test exit 1, `2 of 63 case(s) failed` (the walk's `no_type` and the rendered type row). Restored, blob `ba8debf3e4af` matches HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Live read of the board (report-only, writes nothing)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --since=2026-11-18T06:00:00Z` exit 0 against objectstack-ai/objectstack at 2026-11-19T07:14Z (head 7804d1c46b): 424 open issues enumerated over 5 pages, and the platform also counts 424. ① 1 · ② 0 · ③ 1 · ④ 0 · ⑤ 62. Area backstop 1 card, issue-type backstop 51 cards. The REST row carries `type`: had the field been absent, all 424 cards would have been listed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` still has a comment describing disjunct ③ and H13 as reading `domain:*` (around the `status:parked` label). It is outside this card's file surface and left as is.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` still says `domain:*` 仍定文件归属 in the lane table. That is the lane-to-seat text step, not this card.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on d6f79bbd8a and equally on its base: `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix: VARIANTS STALE — SeedMode ... now has 0 members`. `SeedMode` became `enumWithRetiredValues(SEED_MODE_VALUES, ...)`, which the extractor cannot read. None of this PR's paths are involved, and per `checklist-status.yml` the gate is not in per-PR CI.
- Known textual overlap: an idle PR touching all three files conflicts with this branch, and the card-thread branch `claude/project-thread-rothb5` (no PR yet) conflicts on `check-half-states.mjs` and `triage-duties.md`. Whichever lands second merges main and resolves the conflict. Nothing is pre-resolved here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates (local; CI runs the full set)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 76 families on d6f79bbd8a. All 76 ran locally there; the fix round to 7804d1c46b (same three files) re-ran both self-tests, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` and `check:nul-bytes`, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation exit 0: `76 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- 73 exited 0, including `pnpm check:pm-half-states`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes` and `pnpm check:doc-authoring`.
- NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite): `check:doc-formula-expressions` (needs `@objectstack/formula` built) and `check:i18n-coverage` (needs the CLI built). This diff changes no package, so CI's verdict stands for these two.
- Red, not caused by this diff: `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 1 (see Acceptance notes).
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` exit 0: `triage-duties.md is 108 lines (ceiling 108; headroom 0)`.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0: no anchored file in the change set.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` exit 1: origin/main merges cleanly, the platform-readings PR merges cleanly, and the idle PR noted above conflicts.
- No changeset: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` publish nothing (`skip-changeset`).

</details>

Governed surface (`.claude/**`): this PR stays a draft until its tier's review record exists.
